column1: # The area of each golden case and each shot (#119): tools/affected.py reads this for `make golden-check AREA=...`,
# `make shots AREA=...` and `make check-affected`.  Columns, tab-separated: kind | regex on the name | area.  The first
# row that matches a name gives its area (one area per name; a golden case also has its reel's, apollo11 or apollo8).
# The rules follow the names; exact-name rows (^name$) are the exceptions and come first.  A name no row matches has no
# area: it runs only in a full run and never in a slice, so a new case is never left out of a gate by being new.
# golden: the cases of tools/golden.sh (CASES), and nb-* the notebook figures
